nodes.label: Word details enrichment job (doc, not loaded)
The word-details enrichment job — a second background job on the level job's machinery
nodes.rationale: Kept levelling and enrichment as two independent LLM calls rather than folding into one, because they need different batch sizes (25 vs 4), different model economics (cheap classification vs strong generative model), and different failure isolation; combining them would force re-billing one job whenever the other needs a re-run. Batch size dropped from the level job's 25 to 4 because an enrichment answer is a large nested object and larger batches risk silent truncation.
